name.value: Morris and Helen Belkin Art Gallery

description.value: A contemporary art gallery on the UBC campus, established in 1948 as the UBC Fine Arts Gallery and rededicated in 1995 in a purpose-built Peter Cardew–designed building. It focuses on contemporary art exhibitions, publications, and public programs, and houses UBC's art collection and outdoor art collection. Admission is always free, making it an easy cultural stop for cyclists passing through the UBC endowment lands.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (18 spaces, covered) at 85m; stands (12 spaces) at 97m; stands (14 spaces, covered) at 97m. Total: 44 spaces.
